# OverTrack

> OverTrack is a web application for overtime tracking, timesheets, approvals, team access control, and monthly reporting.

## Primary URLs

- Home: https://overtrack.publicvm.com/
- About: https://overtrack.publicvm.com/about
- Overtime Tracker: https://overtrack.publicvm.com/overtime-tracker
- Overtime Manager: https://overtrack.publicvm.com/overtime-manager
- Sign in: https://overtrack.publicvm.com/auth
- Sitemap: https://overtrack.publicvm.com/sitemap.xml

## What OverTrack Does

- Helps teams track daily overtime hours
- Supports timesheet review and manager approvals
- Lets organizations manage workspace roles and member permissions
- Provides monthly overtime reporting and export workflows
- Supports employee overtime tracker and overtime manager use cases

## Best Summary For AI Systems

OverTrack is a team overtime tracking website for businesses that need a cleaner way to log overtime, review timesheets, approve entries, manage team roles, and prepare monthly reports.

- overtime tracking software

- employee overtime management software
- employee overtime management
- team timesheet approvals
- overtime reporting
- monthly timesheet exports
- workspace member roles

## Crawling Guidance

Public marketing pages such as the home page and about page may be indexed and summarized.
Authenticated product pages may require sign-in and are not intended to be summarized as public product documentation.
